messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired: service_id=svc-redis-cache, severity=high, summary=Cache error spike causing elevated tail latency. PagerDuty incident: PD-48723 -- pages sent to service 'redis-cache'

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: Incident PD-48723 triggered and assigned to schedule 'core-team-oncall' (override: none). Escalation policy 'core-escalation' in use. Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-48723

alex.g: I just got woken up by this. Oncall page came through but the service name looks wrong in the body — it's showing 'redis-cache' but our prod cache is 'redwood-redis-prod'.

sarah.k: same, got the page. I don't see any matching service in PD mapping for redwood-redis-prod -> it might be pointing at an old alias. :eyes:

mike.t: @alex.g @sarah.k quick question — did PD recently roll out the new schedules? I updated rotation last week but didn't touch services.

ops-root: Checking PD service mappings now. Pulling infra config.

ops-root: ```bash
# pd-services.tf (snippet)
resource "pagerduty_service" "redis_cache" {
  name = "redis-cache"
  escalation_policy = "core-escalation"
  acknowledgement_timeout = 300
}
# expected: name = "redwood-redis-prod"
```

carla.s: That TF was changed in the June config bump — looks like a rename never applied to PD after rename in k8s. I can see a PR that updated k8s resource names but didn't adjust PD mapping.

emma: Customer impact: frontend retries for short critical paths slipped from 30ms to 300-800ms for ~12% of requests over 15m window. No errors returned, just degraded latency. We've flagged 23 customers with elevated p50/p95.

alex.g: Ok so root cause is misrouted page + misaligned PD<->k8s naming. We need two things: 1) stoppages going to wrong schedule (so correct on-call handoffs) and 2) fix PD service mapping to point to redwood-redis-prod.

sarah.k: For immediate mitigation — can someone reassign PD incident to 'infra-cache-prod' service (which maps to correct oncall) so the true team gets paged? I can ack once it's reassigned.

ops-root: Manually reassigning in PD console now...

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-48723 reassigned from service 'redis-cache' -> 'infra-cache-prod' by ops-root. New assigned schedule: infra-team-oncall.

alex.g: Ack'ing now. alex.g: :white_check_mark: ACK PD-48723 (now infra-team-oncall)

mike.t: Thanks. infra team please triage latency source — is it overloaded nodes, eviction, or network?

emma: Based on metrics: connection saturation on 3/8 cache nodes, memory pressure + GC spikes after a config churn. Likely consequence of recent config change and a downstream spike.

carla.s: I'll push a hotfix to TF to update the PD service name to match k8s resource names and add a guard in the CI check to validate PD service exists before apply. Proposed patch: add a terraform import and a pre-apply `pd_service_exists` check.

ops-root: Patch ready. Applying to staging PD mapping now.

ops-root: ```bash
# quick guard (pseudo)
if ! pdctl service get "$SERVICE_NAME"; then
  echo "service $SERVICE_NAME missing in PagerDuty -> abort"
  exit 1
fi
```

carla.s: Rolling the change to prod now. ETA ~5m. This will ensure future renames keep PD in sync.

pagerduty-bot: PD mapping update detected: service 'infra-cache-prod' now has aliases ["redwood-redis-prod", "redis-cache"].

alex.g: Double-checking alerts: can we mute the old service alias so alerts don't fire for it again?

ops-root: Muting legacy 'redis-cache' service for 30m to prevent duped pages.

pagerduty-bot: Service 'redis-cache' muted for 30 minutes by ops-root.

emma: Monitoring impact metrics. Latency improving after connection throttles were turned down and two nodes restarted. p95 dropped from 720ms -> 120ms over 10 minutes.

sarah.k: Customer update drafted: "We've corrected a misconfiguration in our alert routing and mitigated the cache saturation causing elevated latency. No data loss. Some customers experienced temporary performance degradation between 02:03-02:20 UTC. Follow-up actions: PD mapping guard added, TF patch merged, and post-incident review scheduled." Approve?

alex.g: LGTM. Add a note about on-call confusion and recommend a quick runbook item to verify service aliases after any resource rename.

carla.s: PR merged to main: add PD guard + alias sync job. I'll open an RFC for an automated reconciliation job between k8s service names and PD services.

mike.t: For postmortem: timeline, impact numbers (23 customers, peak p95 720ms), root cause (PD service mapping drift + cache saturation), remediation (reassign, mute legacy, TF fix), action items (recon job, runbook addendum). I'll own the postmortem doc.

emma: I'll create the incident timeline and gather traces/metrics for the PM.

ops-root: Closing notes: PD incident PD-48723 marked resolved by infra-team at 1765489380.

incident-bot: Incident PD-48723 status changed to RESOLVED by infra-team. Duration: 10m 68s. Tags: pagerduty, routing, oncall, mitigated. :white_check_mark:
